title: Motion atelier
payoff: Feel a real capsule move, jump and land against stairs and a solid block.
limits: Baseline Windows proof only. Synthetic controller event is not physical-controller evidence.

title: Gravity foundry
payoff: Launch a weighted cube and inspect actual impulse, contacts and settling.
limits: No bit-identical cross-host physics or full destruction claim.

title: Pathfinder garden
payoff: Dispatch a courier around a tower to a fixed destination.
limits: No free destination selection, rebaking, crowd avoidance or broad navigation guarantee yet.

title: Paint & light
payoff: Separate painted shade, matte light and vertex shade on comparable geometry.
limits: Baseline uses Compatibility. Global post-effects and all-renderer parity remain planned.

title: Signal chamber
payoff: Hear distance and stereo change around a visible original tone emitter.
limits: Encoded24 kHz stereo proof is not speaker, headphone, comfort or device qualification.

title: Memory archive
payoff: Write earned seals and comfort preferences then reload a real versioned file.
limits: No arbitrary positions, cloud sync or save-slot system. Deep migration work is planned.

title: Tile Workshop
payoff: Paint a playable 2D room and see terrain seams and collision update together.
limits: API/import signatures need an installed-engine probe. Original art only.

title: Animation Loom
payoff: Blend locomotion with a gesture and inspect transition timing rather than swapping clips blindly.
limits: No universal animation cadence or rig compatibility implied.

title: Particle Weather
payoff: Tune a storm and compare CPU/GPU particle behavior under a bounded budget.
limits: Compute/backend capability is probed. Timing belongs to the measured host.

title: Light Archive
payoff: Inspect how baked, authored and dynamic light change the same original room.
limits: Bake dependencies and renderer support require probes. No appearance parity promise.

title: Camera Rig
payoff: Try camera projection and occlusion behavior while moving through a readable course.
limits: Comfort remains a later human gate; screen-space assertions are bounded proxies.

title: Input Atelier
payoff: Rebind actions and see prompts follow actual input events without losing essential controls.
limits: Configured/synthetic pads do not prove a physical controller model.

title: UI Workshop
payoff: Operate a responsive control panel by keyboard and pointer with one predictable focus path.
limits: Screen-reader support needs a separate probe/qualification path.

title: Dialogue Machine
payoff: Choose branches in original dialogue and undo a choice without corrupting story state.
limits: Lab-owned graph contract is proposed, not a built-in Godot dialogue API.

title: Skeleton Studio
payoff: Place targets and inspect constrained skeletal motion and deformation.
limits: Modifier signatures require installed-engine probe; no deprecated IK API assumed.

title: Terrain Foundry
payoff: Sculpt or import terrain and compare visual form, collision and level-of-detail boundaries.
limits: No third-party terrain addon promised. Supported shape/import path is probed.

title: Crowd Balcony
payoff: Compare individual meshes and instancing under the same crowd layout and camera.
limits: Host-specific measurement, not universal speedup; skinned crowds are separate work.

title: Resource Cabinet
payoff: Save and reload a custom Resource while inspecting dependencies and stable identities.
limits: Unknown-field policy must be recorded before schema evolution.

title: Shader Bench
payoff: Adjust uniforms and see clean before/after output while inspecting shader diagnostics.
limits: Shader language/backend availability requires compile probes.

title: Acoustic Rooms
payoff: Compare bus effects, reverb and filters while walking between simple acoustic spaces.
limits: Encoded proof does not establish listening comfort or device routing.

title: Time Laboratory
payoff: See pause, time scaling and interpolation affect simulation without freezing the inspector.
limits: Frame count is not wall time; real-time and fixed-step evidence stay separate.

title: Destruction Cell
payoff: Break an original assembly into bounded physical fragments and rebuild it.
limits: Authored modular breakage, not arbitrary runtime mesh fracturing.

title: Procedural Garden
payoff: Generate a seeded playable layout and inspect connectivity before entering it.
limits: Procedural recipe is lab-owned; no claim of universal level quality.

title: Network Commons
payoff: Join two local processes and inspect server authority and replicated player state.
limits: Local transport proof is not internet/NAT, service or security qualification.

title: Replay Observatory
payoff: Record meaningful operations and replay a versioned semantic timeline.
limits: Does not promise deterministic physics or pixel-identical cross-host output.

title: Editor Toolroom
payoff: Build a small editor panel that changes scene data with working undo/redo.
limits: Editor-only feature; enabling a plugin is distinct from runtime play.

title: Native Bridge
payoff: Compare a narrow GDExtension calculation with a typed GDScript reference.
limits: Exact extension ABI/toolchain must be probed per engine/target.

title: Thread Mill
payoff: Run a bounded cancellable data job without mutating the scene from worker threads.
limits: Pool overhead may exceed gains. Thread-safety rules require a focused probe.

title: Streaming Depot
payoff: Walk across scene boundaries while loading chunks and preserving local changes.
limits: Threaded load is not free scene-tree mutation; actual resource path is probed.

title: Large World
payoff: Explore precision at large distances and compare an explicit origin strategy.
limits: Double-precision builds and engine limits are separate probes, never assumed.

title: Renderer Gallery
payoff: Compare the same fixture across Compatibility, Mobile and Forward+ with explicit support gates.
limits: Renderer switching may require restart; API/hardware availability is probed.

title: Web Portal
payoff: Export a small route and try browser-specific input, storage and restart behavior.
limits: Browser automation is not mobile browser/device proof. Threading headers are explicit.

title: Mobile Field Kit
payoff: Try touch controls and sensor adapters with visible simulated/real distinction.
limits: Physical mobile evidence deferred; SDK/signing/toolchain must be probed.

title: XR Room
payoff: Interact through tracked input while inspecting real versus fixture poses.
limits: No headset/controller qualification until physical test; extension names probed.

title: Import Studio
payoff: Inspect imported meshes, materials and animation against original source fixtures.
limits: Exact import option names/version require probes; no copied commercial assets.

title: Profiling Booth
payoff: Measure a controlled expensive scene before and after one explained optimization.
limits: No universal performance threshold or hardware claim without measurements.

title: Capability Compass
payoff: Find a capability by payoff and see exactly why its live route is available or gated.
limits: Readiness is a current probe, not a permanent platform promise.

title: Operation Desk
payoff: Invoke one typed operation from UI and automation and compare receipts and undo.
limits: Proposed lab-owned contract, not arbitrary remote code execution.

title: Fixture Pantry
payoff: Choose safe original fixtures and preview their bounds before committing them to a lab.
limits: Only approved original/licensed inputs; no automatic arbitrary-path import.

title: Pause Vestibule
payoff: Pause, resume and leave an active lab while inspecting cleanup and focus handoff.
limits: Only lab-owned work may be cancelled or reset.

title: Signal Switchboard
payoff: Wire events between scene objects and inspect ordering, disconnection and duplicate subscription.
limits: Ordering policy belongs to this lab; not a universal global event bus.

title: 2D Movement
payoff: Compare forgiving jump controls with exact collision in a compact2D platform course.
limits: Input comfort needs later human testing; timing measured in declared ticks.

title: Combat Clock
payoff: Land a readable attack and inspect hitboxes, invulnerability, hitstop and cancel timing.
limits: Original mechanics only; not rollback determinism or production combat balance.

title: Ledge Course
payoff: Traverse slope, wall and ledge states while inspecting transition guards.
limits: No comfortable movement claim without human testing.

title: Platform Ferry
payoff: Ride translating/rotating platforms and compare inherited velocity on departure.
limits: Godot platform-motion properties are compile/probe leads; no all-controller equivalence.

title: Aim Range
payoff: Compare ray, shape and projectile targeting with readable occlusion and collision masks.
limits: No weapon-art or commercial game content; continuous projectile proof is separate.

title: Navigation Traffic
payoff: Dispatch several agents through a bottleneck and inspect avoidance versus path planning.
limits: Avoidance does not guarantee perfect deadlock resolution or internet synchronization.

title: Joint Arcade
payoff: Connect2D bodies with pin/spring/groove joints and inspect limits and break policy.
limits: Physics tolerances are host/version-specific; no bit-identical replay promise.

title: Constraint Foundry
payoff: Manipulate3D mechanical joints and inspect angular limits and solver stability.
limits: Joint solver behavior needs engine-specific acceptance rather than universal stability claims.

title: Field Chamber
payoff: Move bodies through gravity, damping and trigger zones and inspect overlap policy.
limits: Exact gravity override priorities require installed-engine probe.

title: Cloth Sail
payoff: Pin and release a small soft-body sail and inspect deformation and collision cost.
limits: Soft-body availability/performance is a probe; no realistic fabric claim.

title: Collision Switchyard
payoff: Toggle layers/masks and see which bodies, triggers and queries can interact.
limits: Physics contact, trigger and query rules are distinguished; no implicit global policy.

title: Ballistics Tunnel
payoff: Fire fast objects at thin obstacles and compare discrete/continuous collision behavior.
limits: Backend/version-sensitive CCD properties need probes. No unbounded velocity guarantee.

title: Ragdoll Recovery
payoff: Switch an original rig between animation and physical bones and inspect recovery.
limits: Exact physical-bone API requires probe; no general retargeting guarantee.

title: Grid Tactics
payoff: Plan and execute a turn on a2D grid with cost, occupancy and undoable commands.
limits: Lab-owned tactics contract; not a built-in combat framework.

title: Voxel Quarry
payoff: Edit a tiny voxel volume and inspect meshing, collision and chunk seams.
limits: Custom bounded meshing, not an implied built-in voxel engine.

title: Navmesh Workshop
payoff: Move an obstacle and inspect the difference between navigation rebake and runtime avoidance.
limits: Bake/source signatures are version-sensitive probes; avoidance alone is not rebaking.

title: World Clock
payoff: Advance a scoped day/weather clock and inspect gameplay triggers and visual change separately.
limits: No OS clock manipulation; visual interpolation and logical schedule remain separate.

title: LOD Walk
payoff: Walk an identical camera route and inspect mesh detail transitions, culling and visual discontinuity.
limits: Exact LOD/occlusion support probed per renderer; cost is measured not promised.

title: Atlas Author
payoff: Paint a tiny original motif atlas and inspect UV padding, sampling and repetition on modular geometry.
limits: Texture size is a project choice. Whole-atlas repeat is not subregion tiling.

title: Vertex Shade
payoff: Paint broad shade on geometry and inspect interpolation and triangulation before adding lights.
limits: No claim that every imported format preserves colors without round-trip test.

title: Silhouette Studio
payoff: Compare original low-poly character shapes at gameplay and close-up distances.
limits: Automated masks are proxies; preference/expressiveness need later human judgment.

title: Stepped Animation
payoff: Compare stepped pose sampling with smooth simulation/camera response.
limits: No universal on-twos rule inferred from references; comfort is untested.

title: Shadow Cards
payoff: Place authored contact gradients and shafts and inspect their camera-angle limits.
limits: Cards are not volumetric lighting or physically correct moving shadows.

title: Fog Theater
payoff: Compare depth haze and supported volumetric fog around readable silhouettes.
limits: Volumetric support is renderer-specific and must be probed.

title: Viewport Mirrors
payoff: Look through a live portal/monitor and inspect camera, texture and input forwarding boundaries.
limits: Portal illusion scope is explicit; no unlimited recursion or arbitrary cross-app capture.

title: Decal Printing
payoff: Place original projected marks and compare them with mesh-backed marks under supported renderers.
limits: Decal renderer support is probed; mesh fallback is not identical projection.

title: Display Laboratory
payoff: Compare clean, pixel-scaled, palette and optional CRT output without weakening controls.
limits: Filters optional. No historical-hardware accuracy implied by visual resemblance.

title: Compute Garden
payoff: Run a small compute fixture and compare output against a CPU reference with honest availability.
limits: RenderingDevice/backend/thread ownership signatures need probes. No Compatibility compute promise.

title: Tone Observatory
payoff: Compare exposure, tone mapping and color grading while preserving meaningful luminance roles.
limits: Encoded SDR images cannot prove an HDR display. Output color management recorded explicitly.

title: Mixer Desk
payoff: Route original stems into lab-owned buses and inspect gain, solo and clipping safely.
limits: Comfort/loudness requires later listening judgment; no mastering-quality claim.

title: Music Conductor
payoff: Change intensity on a beat boundary and inspect synchronized stems rather than abrupt restarts.
limits: New stream APIs require installed-engine probes; no rhythm-game latency guarantee.

title: Voice & Captions
payoff: Play original speech with timed captions and compare transcript, timing and audible evidence.
limits: ASR is draft evidence; reviewed authoritative captions are required. No microphone permission assumed.

title: Statechart Playhouse
payoff: Manipulate a small character state machine and inspect guards, entry/exit and interrupted actions.
limits: Lab-owned statechart contract, not an implied Godot behavior-tree feature.

title: Quest Weave
payoff: Complete original objectives in different orders and inspect dependency and undo semantics.
limits: No production economy or arbitrary script execution in quest data.

title: Cinematic Rails
payoff: Compose an interactive camera/animation sequence with skip, resume and bounded cancellation.
limits: A movie route does not substitute for player interaction or human camera-comfort testing.

title: Inventory Alchemy
payoff: Combine original items and inspect transactional recipes, limits and undo.
limits: Project-owned game economy example; no purchase or payment path.

title: Locale Pavilion
payoff: Switch original translations and inspect text direction, plural rules and saved language choice.
limits: RTL/font shaping and translation quality need platform-specific review; no OS language change.

title: Focus Labyrinth
payoff: Navigate menus, dialogs and a3D panel with keyboard focus and inspect accessibility probes.
limits: Automated focus is not screen-reader/human accessibility qualification. API support probed.

title: Comfort Controls
payoff: Tune motion, flash, text and input assists with immediate preview and scoped persistence.
limits: Preview checks do not prove comfort. Avoid compulsory rapid flashing.

title: Drag & Inspect
payoff: Drag typed resources between panels and inspect validation, preview and undo.
limits: No automatic adoption of arbitrary external files; focus behavior tested separately.

title: Prediction Track
payoff: Compare authoritative motion with client prediction and reconciliation under controlled delay.
limits: Networked physics determinism not assumed; no competitive-game guarantee.

title: Reconnect Harbor
payoff: Drop and rejoin a local session without duplicating owned entities or losing committed state.
limits: Local session tokens are scoped fixtures, not production authentication.

title: Network Chaos
payoff: Inject loss, jitter, duplication and reordering and inspect recovery instead of hiding transport failures.
limits: Fault adapter is proposed lab tooling; actual wire loss is distinct from synthetic event replay.

title: RPC Gatehouse
payoff: Send allowed and invalid RPC requests and inspect authority, payload limits and version checks.
limits: No arbitrary remote eval. Production authentication/encryption needs separate design.

title: WebRTC Bridge
payoff: Connect two browser-capable peers through an explicit local signaling adapter and inspect failure modes.
limits: Native plugin/browser requirements are probes. No public NAT/STUN service assumption.

title: Live Control
payoff: Drive a running lab through a narrow typed command channel and inspect cancellation and receipts.
limits: No arbitrary code/OS command execution. Official Cappy protocol must be probed rather than invented.

title: Source-bound Capture
payoff: Capture only the declared game window/process and verify the source identity before accepting media.
limits: Provider capture distinct from Godot movie writing. Credentials stay local; no desktop fallback.

title: Parameter Sweeps
payoff: Schedule bounded scenario variations and compare their actual outcomes with resumable jobs.
limits: Heavy encoding uses approved separate host policy; no infinite autonomous recording loop.

title: Camera Takes
payoff: Author reusable camera routes and record them without disabling ordinary playable scenes.
limits: Camera route is media tooling, never replacement for live player navigation.

title: Golden Assertions
payoff: Compare declared image/audio/state regions and inspect why a regression passes or fails.
limits: Tolerances avoid brittle exact pixels; passing metrics do not establish overall artistic quality.

title: Memory Observatory
payoff: Repeat entry/reset/exit and inspect resource growth, leaks and bounded caches.
limits: OS memory noise distinguished from owned-object counts; no universal RAM threshold.

title: Import Plugin
payoff: Import an original custom data format through editor tooling with reimport and diagnostics.
limits: Exact plugin hooks require installed-editor probe. Import does not execute arbitrary source code.

title: Export Profiles
payoff: Build explicit native/web profiles and inspect included assets, runtime route and unsupported gates.
limits: Native Windows/macOS/Linux targets need separate builds; signed distribution and physical proof distinct.

title: Blender Round Trip
payoff: Carry an original rigged, vertex-painted modular asset from source to Godot and back through a bounded interchange path.
limits: Blender/plugin versions require probes. Godot export may not preserve every authoring feature.

title: XR Hands
payoff: Inspect tracked or recorded hands, pinch grabs and loss-of-tracking behavior on original objects.
limits: Hand tracking extensions and API signatures need probes; no hardware qualification from fixture replay.
